Not necessarily. The sources measure different things: Hansen records the year of stand-replacing tree-cover loss at 30 m resolution, while JRC maps forest versus non-forest in 2020 at 10 m resolution. Hansen’s 67.7 ha of loss in 2020 can therefore coexist with JRC’s finding of no forest in its 2020 reference map. The evidence does not establish the exact reason for the difference.

The 2020 loss is also **before the 31 December 2020 baseline**, so it is outside the assessed 2021–2025 period. For that later period, no loss event of at least 0.5 ha was detected; 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches was recorded in 2021.
